lines.en: This is not the bed I ordered.
I know! You must have won, like, a contest or something.
Why is this car in my bedroom?
I'm sorry, okay? I wasn't looking,
and the store said that they won't take it back
When did I sign for it?
When I was you. You know what?
It's all Joey's fault because he left his nose open.
Quick, take off your dress. You won't notice the bed.
Hey, I'm going for sushi. Does anybody want, uh...
So this has always been Monica's bed.
Okay, well, if this bed isn't new,
then how come there's plastic on the mattress?
